Ava: Weekend poll — thinking low-key this weekend. Pottery class + potluck Saturday morning, or forest bath + boardgames Sunday? 🍶🌲 Thoughts?
Ravi: Pottery sounds fun! Can we bring our own snacks? :yum:
Marta: Forest bath for me — need a tree hug. I can bring Catan and snacks if it helps.
Jon: Pottery link?
Ava: https://pottery-studio.example.com/class/42 still has spots for Saturday 10am. I'd be up for splitting a class of 4.
Jon: Hmm might be booked by the time I check, but if not I'll join. If not, I'll swing by for the potluck.
Ravi: Count me in for pottery + potluck. Also can bring a salad.
Marta: If there are spots left, I could do pottery earlier but I'd rather forest + games. Either is fine.
DevBot: FYI: Building maintenance Saturday 9–11am; lobby access may be limited. :wrench:
Ava: Thanks for the heads-up @DevBot. Final plan so far: Saturday 10am pottery + potluck (Ava, Ravi, maybe Jon), Sunday forest walk + boardgames (Marta). Anyone else want in? Ping me. Also please bring reusable plates/cups! :recycle:
